authored_assumptions: The supplied opaque 2D portrait supplies appearance only; back, underside, rig, topology, UVs, weights and fur placement are newly authored.
Browser fur is a bounded skinned cutout-card groom; native Blender hair is separate editable geometry and is not exported as GLB hair. Neither representation simulates hair dynamics.
Arms and legs have continuous meshes with blended two-bone skinning. Torso, head, paws and facial components remain separate authored surfaces.
Eyes, eyelids, nose, mouth and paw digits are modeled geometry, not independently actuated facial muscles or fingers.
The green dragon stays attached to the torso-side anatomical-right shoulder helper; head, tail and wings have local authored controls only.
The golden orb is an authored action prop, not part of the reference portrait. Crafting gestures do not change its geometry or simulate manufacture.
General PBR edition: embedded normal maps, short fur and glossy surfaces have not been reduced to or approved by the Weft diffuse-only profile.
All native glTF transforms are authored meters/Y-up/+Z-front after Blender export; scale is not calibrated to the live simulator.
The neutral pose is arms resting beside the rounded body, feet flat, face forward; it is not an observed simulator pose.
The new continuous head deformation authors the muzzle and chin from visual interpretation; it is not a scan, image-to-mesh recovery or a new face control rig.
Iris and pupil geometry are glossy opaque curved shells. There is no refractive transparent cornea, painted catchlight or eye-tracking behavior.
Every iris uses disk UV0 centered at [0.5,0.5], rim radius 0.5; the central pupil shell covers part of the native radial color texture.
Dragon horn ridges, visible crown scales and thickened curved wing membranes are authored geometry; the remaining scales are procedural surface detail.

The retained emitters previously used 17,820 triangular strands. This recipe requests 7,128 six-vertex skinned ribbons with fiber cutouts and approximately 71,500 native parent/child hairs; counts are configuration, not independently counted rendered fibers.
The two-channel surface plan allocates 22,544,384 texture pixels; HD surface support must be validated before rendering this recipe.
No new clip boundary, visual quality or hair-density claim follows from preserving authored keys. Native render and exported-model inspection remain required.

limitations: Native Blender hair is not exported as glTF geometry or browser hair.

The caller caps aggregate fibers at 80000 and excludes native groom objects from GLB selection.

uv_repair.method: Per-loop geometric-plane UV projection for collapsed UVs or cancelling UV fans; other UV seams unchanged. Tangents are computed by Blender MikkTSpace, not replaced.

generation.local_compute: CPU, up to 4 threads; resource usage in job.json

origin: Agent-authored procedural geometry and skeletal keyframes; not neural reconstruction or an analytic fixture
preview_scope: portrait only; four exported clips still independently skin-tested

references.role: User-supplied Muse appearance reference; authored stylized interpretation, not recovered geometry

attachments.placement: Anatomical right/viewer-left shoulder; dragon root [-0.57,-0.045,1.40] meters in author Z-up space.
Small golden orb at the right paw; follows the right hand through actual skeletal transforms.

motion.method: CPU linear-blend skinning at bounded key/midpoint samples

rig_verification.rest_pose: Authored default bone transforms. Blender Z-up/-Y-front exported to glTF Y-up/+Z-front.
rig_verification.visual_review: required; materials/textures are not rendered by this validator

rights: New locally authored shapes/materials; reference resemblance is not independent rights verification

states.meaning: Panda breathes and gives a small friendly head tilt while its shoulder dragon nods and curls its tail.
Panda brings the small golden orb between both paws and works it with alternating short rubbing/rolling gestures; the orb is not replaced or reshaped.
Panda raises the golden orb toward its eyes and angles its head for close inspection, then lowers it.
Panda lifts both paws and presents the orb in a celebratory pose while the shoulder dragon opens its wings; no physical jump is claimed.

style: Soft storybook panda with sculpted expressive face, layered glossy warm eyes and an organically modeled emerald shoulder dragon
subject: Muse-inspired white-and-charcoal panda with a small green dragon on its anatomical right shoulder (world -X, viewer-left), authored as a complete articulated 3D toy.
